thread:
nina: Observed a burst where policy kept sending hedges to a region that had a short-lived cb. p50 fine but p99 spiked.
leo: Did runtime surface the cb?
nina: No, we only had 30s-old telemetry. runtime had CB open for ~90s.
tara: Proposal: let runtime emit a compact hint header on response path: X-Rt-Hint: cb_s=90;penalty=0.4;ts=1705000000. Policy can use it for immediate decisions.
leo: Important: sign the header for private clusters. infra-bot: :robot_face: add X-Rt-Hint-Sig HMAC.
tara: Scoring tweak: apply penalty as an additive term to avoid huge reweights. score = base - w_lat*lat - w_cost*cost - w_pen*penalty.
nina: Also add a probe backoff: initial probe_after = 10s, double up to 300s. avoid probe storms.
leo: Edge-case: clock skew. policy accepts hint only if |now - ts| < 120s, otherwise ignore and metric.policy.hint_skew++.
tara: Action items: LB/runtime: opt-in header + HMAC (tara). Policy: parse hint, enforce skew, apply penalty and backoff (leo). Infra: secret rotation docs (infra-bot).
infra-bot: :calendar: opt-in rollout planned: canary Tue -> region rollouts Thu.
